articles.summary: As Ardmore continues to align operational performance with crew wellbeing and environmental impact, we’re always looking for new and practical ways to embed innovation into our daily operations. One of our latest initiatives, the introduction of hydroponic growing systems, is a small but meaningful step in that direction. It supports several of the priorities outlined Ardmore’s Susanne Deane explores how hydroponic growing systems are enhancing crew wellbeing, sustainability, and fresh food production onboard vessels and ashore.
articles.title: Ardmore rolls out hydroponics for sustainability and wellbeing
